$comment: Single source of truth for the AACA Attendance Dataverse schema. Applied by provisioning/Deploy-Schema.ps1. Choice values use the publisher option prefix 58210 (582100000+). Never renumber an existing choice value; append new ones.

tables.description: A school campus. Maps to a business unit of the same name.

columns.description: GUID of the campus business unit's default team (set by Deploy-Security.ps1); flows assign new campus records to it.
Teams group chat that receives the campus ABSENCE ALERT cards (set per environment).

tables.description: App user profile. App Role drives the UI only; data access comes from security roles.

columns.description: Shows the Billing app to this person. Data access comes from the AACA Finance security role.
Receives the weekly open-items summary for their campus.
Work email. The access flow links the Staff row to the user account with this email.
Set when the person is retired (Active = No).

tables.description: A student. Owned by the student's current teacher. Never deleted; archived instead.

primaryName.description: Last, First. Set by the app on save.

columns.description: Server-assigned number used to build the Student Key (campus code at intake + '-' + this). Seed set above the highest existing key (1128 on 2026-10-01).
Student Key (e.g. CW-1083). Required, unique, read-only after creation; used by the SharePoint Student Directory and parent absence form.
Regional Center Only students receive services outside school (RC- keys); they have no enrollment or attendance. Blank = School.
CALPADS categories.

columns.displayName: Current Year Enrollment Forms on File

columns.description: California special education eligibility category.
Community-based instruction release.

tables.description: A billable or tracked service: Special Education (SAI) attendance, day services (aide, BII, transportation, HNS) and CodeMetro clinical services. QuickBooks item and billing unit are maintained by finance.

columns.description: School Day = billed in days from attendance; Clinical = billed from CodeMetro minutes.
Unit the QuickBooks item bills in. Clinical minutes are converted to decimal hours for Hours items.
No = shown on the RDS but never invoiced (e.g. no-show codes).

tables.description: A school year including its summer program (e.g. Aug 2026 - Jul 2027).
Quarter, summer program (ESY) or testing period date range. Quarters are back-to-back (no school-day gaps). Testing is informational. Blank campus = applies to all campuses.
A non-school weekday (holiday, break, closed, work only, inclement weather) or a make-up school day. Name = the label shown on the calendar. Blank campus = all campuses.
One continuous assignment of a student to a teacher/campus/ratio. Closed and replaced on change; never deleted. Owned by the teacher.

columns.description: Blank = open-ended within the school year.

tables.description: Maintainable list of absence reasons. Required when an absence is Excused.
One row per student, service and date. Snapshot columns preserve history. Owned by the recording teacher. Soft-deleted only.

columns.description: Blank = Not classified. Only meaningful when Present = No.
SharePoint Student Absence Log item ID of the parent report whose approval created or classified this absence.
Who created the record: teacher mark, parent absence report (intake flow) or office entry.
When the parent report arrived (SharePoint Created time). Used for the 24-hour billable-notice rule.
A parent reported this day absent but the teacher had already marked present: the office decides (Classify tab).
Office-recorded partial day: the student attended and left early.

tables.description: Month-end lock per campus. Month = first day of the month.
Key/value configuration.
Business action with reason, for the in-app audit viewer. Built-in Dataverse auditing is the tamper-proof record. Who/when = Created By/On.
One row per parent absence report (SharePoint Student Absence Log item) that office staff approved or dismissed. Its presence means the report is done.

columns.description: Intake flow result. Error rows appear in the Mapping Errors tab.
Days the teacher had already marked present (flagged, not overwritten).

tables.description: Family portal: links a parent or guardian (Contact) to one student. Only linked, active guardians see the student in the portal. Owned by the student's campus team. Name = the guardian's display name (e.g. 'Jose Lopez'), shown to co-guardians instead of their contact details.

An absence report from any source (website form, office entry, family portal, SharePoint import). Notice At is the official notice time for billing. A flow matches the student and creates the attendance days.

columns.description: Same as First Day Absent for a single day.
Official notice time for the billing rules: time received (website), time the parent told the office (office), submitted (portal), Date Notified (import).
The website's own submission stamp (DN), for reference.
Expected date of return as given (the student is back that day).
SharePoint Student Absence Log item ID (imported history).

tables.description: A student's emergency contact (up to 3, by priority). Shown read-only to the student's guardians in the family portal.
A medication a student takes. Shown read-only to the student's guardians in the family portal.
Who pays: a school district, regional center or private payer, with its QuickBooks customer.
A Funding Source name as CodeMetro writes it (normalised: trimmed, single spaces, upper case), mapped to a Funder.
A CPT Code or Service Name as CodeMetro writes it (normalised, upper case), mapped to a Service.
The funder that pays a student's school days (SAI) for a date range.
One RDS grid row a student is entitled to, from the CodeMetro student services export (a 2:1 aide = two rows).

columns.description: Finance override: ignore this row for the RDS and billing.
Identity of the CodeMetro row (student|code|funder|start|end|occurrence) used to update on re-import.

tables.description: One CodeMetro services-rendered file. It replaces all delivered services dated within its date range (open months only). Rows In = rows on grids (sessions) + exceptions.
Delivered minutes for one student + funder + service + day, summed from CodeMetro session rows.

columns.description: StudentKey|yyyy-mm-dd|ServiceCode|FunderAbbreviation

tables.description: A CodeMetro row that could not be placed on a grid, with the reason. Nothing is dropped silently.
A student receives transportation services from Start to End (blank = ongoing), with their usual pattern. Managed by campus office staff.
How a transported student was handled on one school day, confirmed by campus office staff by the end of the day.

columns.description: StudentKey|yyyy-mm-dd (one row per student per day)

tables.description: A finance-managed rule that decides whether an absence (later: transportation) day is billable, for which services, from when.

columns.description: Late notice: billable when notice arrived fewer than this many hours before the school start time.
HH:mm, Pacific (e.g. 09:00).
Blank = all funder types.
Blank = still in effect.
Lower runs first; the first matching rule decides.

tables.description: A service a billing rule applies to (one row per rule + service).

columns.description: RuleId|ServiceId

tables.description: The billing result for one student, service and school day, written by the billing rules engine (never in locked months).

columns.description: StudentNumber|ServiceCode|yyyy-mm-dd

lookups.description: Blank until the person has an account. One Staff row per user (checked by Grant-AacaAccess and the integrity check).
Deleting the contact removes its links.
Blank until matched (Match Status Unmatched/Ambiguous) or mapped by the office.
Family portal guardian (Contact); blank for website and office notices.
Category chosen by the office when classifying (website reports send free text in Reason Text).
Set by the campus-assignment flow from the student's active enrollment.
The absence report that created this day.
